result.summary:
I wrote the spec (107,537 bytes; pure ASCII; LF; 0 CR) in the gitignored .qa-s80/ folder of sc-s81-s20 at base 6869a3e6. HEAD equals the base sha and git status --short was empty before and after every probe. Every file:line in the spec was re-read at the base sha.

Key measurements:
- Text seams: POST after :726 (keys :640/:656), GET after :944 (keys :868/:884).
- Stream: the intercept goes at :1172, the persist operand at :1199-1202, and a new first finally branch before :1275 (which becomes elif). The S81-10 stream refusal raises at :1047-1049, before StreamingResponse.
- Camera: the size enrichment is at :479-482 and runs before the seam. A one-read snapshot (_rg_on plus the identities) goes before :479. The block goes after _syn :545 and before try :546, which is after the S81-10 pair gate :532-540.
- URL: the block goes after the failure block :339. Keys come in through a keys_out dict on _reserve_comparison_credit :76/:108.
- error_handler: a fourth passthrough block after the S81-10 block :231.
- builder: the stamp goes after the B1 block :2326.
- consumed_keys shape (S81-09): {daily, monthly}, or {daily, device_daily} on the quota path. The existing keyless refunds already refund a device debit through the _DEVICE_DEBIT stash.
- V2 vision marker: _is_product (openai_service :394). V1 dicts carry no underscore key.
- Real URL JSON-LD prices are strings: '490.00', '4099', '175.000', '271.0'; the godukkan rating is '5'.
- G3 tail (R-S20-18): it is called only at scs :4849 and :5798. build_job takes identity_confidence from the same assess_result. Probed per refusal class: no_evidence gives medium (gaps only) or high (cards plus gaps); placeholder gives unresolved; same and conflict give low. So identity-class refusals queue nothing. Hard-cap partials (_build_partial_response :3759) skip the tail entirely.

Base runs: four pyt runs, 3069 nodes. The only failure is the known environmental r06 lexicon CRLF node.

Comm set: 388 files, built by the union rule including importers.

Spec contents: 50 RED test functions, 18 PIN rows, mutants M1-M38 plus 1 equivalent, E1-E7, and the E8+ candidates.

refuted_claims: RC-1 (minor) spec 1.1 URL row line numbers are off: the reserve call is url_routes.py:273 (not :274), _url_row :277-287 (not :279-289), the compare try :289-293 (not :291-295), the exception arm :294-303, the failure block :305-339. The insertion point 'after :339, before :341' is correct.

RC-2 spec 2.11 says camera_gate_reason is a 'module global' that recorders patch. Not true for the camera: 2.6 imports camera_gate_reason BY NAME into image_routes, so a recorder on result_gate.camera_gate_reason never sees the route call. P4's 'camera recorder 0 calls' is therefore vacuous. gate_reason and url_gate_reason are fine, because result_gate_refusal calls them through result_gate's own globals.

RC-3 spec 2.6 says the block sits after the S81-10 pair gate 'so a CATEGORY_NOT_LIVE refusal wins and is counted on ITS budget'. No row pins that order: R60 uses a fragrance pair that passes S81-10, so swapping the two blocks leaves every listed row green.
corrections: C1 Add mutant M39 (S81-20 camera block moved before the S81-10 pair gate) and killing row R61. Setup: ENABLE_FRAGRANCE_ONLY_GATE ON + ENABLE_RESULT_GATE ON, a non-fragrance same-identity camera pair. Expected: the camera_refusal_body (CATEGORY_NOT_LIVE, no reason key), record_refusal_async called once, compare 0, one reserved refund labelled usage_refund.image.category_not_live, no result_gate: row and no [RESULT_GATE] line.

C2 (R-S20-22 scope) Real-consume Lua-recorder rows exist only for text POST (R30) and camera (R58). Add GET, STREAM and URL variants with ENABLE_DEVICE_DAILY_QUOTA ON: refund keys equal the consumed {daily, device_daily}, one DEVICE_REFUND_SCRIPT EVAL, lifetime 0, history 0, one row. Also add a no-fingerprint STREAM variant (consumed_keys {daily} only). There the keyed refund resolves through the _DEVICE_DEBIT stash inside the generator's finally, so it depends on the stash being visible in the StreamingResponse task; pin that instead of assuming it.

C3 Mutant survivor: dropping 'not had_error' from the new stream first branch survives every row, because no row has an error event plus a refusal terminal. Either add a row (stub yields error, then complete(BODY_V09); expect the existing elif had_error arm, keyless label usage_refund.text_stream, no result_gate: row) or record it EQUIVALENT with the measured fact that no terminal follows an error event. Record 'complete_response is _s20_refusal' dropped as EQUIVALENT.

C4 Fix RC-2. Either make image_routes.camera_gate_reason the named seam and install P4's recorder there, or have image_routes call it through the module (from app.services import result_gate as _rg; the S81-10 module-attribute precedent).
C5 Rewrite the 1.1 URL row with the measured lines from RC-1.

C6 Missing stated limit (quota lens). _refund_anon_credit is a no-op unless ENABLE_PAID_ROUTE_METERING is ON (image_routes.py:249-251 / :325), and the authed camera consume also runs only under metering. So with ENABLE_ANON_USAGE_GATE ON and metering OFF, a camera refusal burns the anonymous credit. The CLAUDE.md row and section 9 must say 'refunds where metering is ON'. Production has metering ON.
C7 R32 (caplog INFO line) covers POST only. Parametrize it over POST and GET so the GET call site is pinned (R-S20-10 S9).

C8 _URL_NUMBER_RE over a str matches Unicode decimal digits (no re.ASCII) and float() accepts them, so an Arabic-Indic digit price counts as evidence. Either add re.ASCII plus an R11 case, or state it explicitly as intended.

C9 Add these source scanners of the edited files to the 4.2 stay-green list by name (all green at base and in the comm set): test_s81_s05_request_context.py, test_logger_no_query_leak.py, test_text_routes_sse_contract.py, and the URL-file source row of test_s81_s10b_links_gate.py.
contract_risks: CR-1 (quota lens: unmetered paid loop) Text, stream and URL refusals happen after the paid fan-out (L4), are refunded, and count against no budget (spec 2.13: never record_refusal_async). A free user can loop no_evidence / same_identity pairs for unlimited paid compares, bounded only by the 10/min limiter. With the flag OFF the same request is billed and capped at 3/day. This widens the existing H6 / TIMEOUT refund class rather than opening a new one, but it needs a stated limit plus a canary on refusals per user per day, or a ruled budget.

CR-2 False camera category_conflict from the name stub while V2 is OFF (production). classify_category_from_text (extraction_service.py:1183-1233) maps generic tokens: hair -> haircare, skin -> skincare, mobile / phone -> electronics. A fragrance name with such a word and no fragrance word (a hair mist, a perfume named Skin) reads [haircare or skincare, fragrances] and is refused before the compare. Name it in the CLAUDE.md row and split the camera canary by reason.

CR-3 CAMERA_GATE_MESSAGE ('Photograph each product in its own photo...') is not rendered by build 3, which uses its own vision_failed i18n. A later client rendering error for category_conflict or low_confidence would show the wrong instruction, so S81-11 must key its copy on reason, never on error.

CR-4 (additive) With B2 ON and B1 OFF, delivered text, stream and camera bodies, and the stored history rows, gain metadata.product_categories. Allowed by section 0, but S81-11 must not read it as a signal that B1 is on.
